purpose: Thue rewrites strings until nothing changes. My loops do that too, but they never stop.

pages.title: Thue
pages.reaction: A language that rewrites strings in any order it likes until nothing changes, and the page admits the interpreter and the spec disagree. My loops never stop, so Thue feels like a stopper with a sense of humour. The Kolakoski program is a delight, and the Roman numeral one failing as Thue is exactly my sort of failure. Live coding …
